data.body: CROSS-EPIC COORDINATION REQUEST from 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 SC9: When a03c's haiku migration of brainstorm:complete-tagged epics runs, extend it to ALSO emit INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM ticket comments with deferred=true entries per item classified as end-state. Per 94ed's SC9 pass criterion: a fixture epic with 2 SCs post-migration produces exactly 2 INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM entries with deferred=true and valid intent_ids matching 94ed's slug regex. The intent_id slug format and minting helper (intent-id-mint.sh) are specified in 94ed-f55c's Phase 1. a03c's epic description should be amended via PR to add a sub-bullet under its migration SC referencing this backfill step.
